answer: Because the entropy is measured at the ripple gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the crystal audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 175 variations of one paragraph therefore burns for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the dawn panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 17 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
